using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
namespace __PACKAGE__;
/// <summary>Standard Webhooks HMAC v1. Persist webhook-id separately for replay deduplication.</summary>
public static class StandardWebhooks {
    public sealed class VerificationException : ArgumentException { public VerificationException(string reason) : base(reason) {} }
    private static VerificationException Fail(string reason) => new(reason);
    private static byte[] Base64(string encoded) {
        if (!System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(encoded, @"\A(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?\z")) throw Fail("invalid webhook encoding");
        try { return Convert.FromBase64String(encoded); } catch(FormatException) { throw Fail("invalid webhook encoding"); }
    }
    public static byte[] Verify(byte[] body, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string,IEnumerable<string>>> headers, IEnumerable<string> secrets, double? now = null, double tolerance = 300) {
        double clock = now ?? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds();
        if (body is null || !double.IsFinite(clock) || !double.IsFinite(tolerance) || tolerance < 0) throw Fail("invalid webhook verification options");
        var metadata = new Dictionary<string,string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach(var header in headers) {
            if (!new[]{"webhook-id","webhook-timestamp","webhook-signature"}.Contains(header.Key, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
            var values = header.Value.ToArray();
            if(values.Length != 1 || values[0] is null || !metadata.TryAdd(header.Key, values[0])) throw Fail("duplicate webhook metadata header");
        }
        var id = metadata.GetValueOrDefault("webhook-id","");
        var stamp = metadata.GetValueOrDefault("webhook-timestamp","");
        if (id.Length == 0 || id.Contains('.') || !System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(stamp, @"\A[0-9]+\z") || !long.TryParse(stamp,out var timestamp)) throw Fail("invalid webhook metadata");
        if(Math.Abs(clock-timestamp)>tolerance) throw Fail("webhook timestamp outside tolerance");
        var keys = new List<byte[]>();
        foreach(var secret in secrets) {
            if(secret is null || !secret.StartsWith("whsec_",StringComparison.Ordinal)) throw Fail("invalid webhook signing secret");
            var key=Base64(secret[6..]); if(key.Length<24 || key.Length>64) throw Fail("invalid webhook signing secret"); keys.Add(key);
        }
        if(keys.Count==0) throw Fail("trusted webhook signing secret required");
        var prefix=Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(id+"."+stamp+"."); var signed=new byte[prefix.Length+body.Length];
        prefix.CopyTo(signed,0);body.CopyTo(signed,prefix.Length);
        bool valid=false;
        foreach(var entry in metadata.GetValueOrDefault("webhook-signature","").Split((char[]?)null,StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)) {
            if(!entry.StartsWith("v1,",StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
            byte[] signature;try {signature=Base64(entry[3..]);}catch(VerificationException){continue;}
            if(signature.Length!=32)continue;
            foreach(var key in keys) valid |= CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(HMACSHA256.HashData(key,signed),signature);
        }
        if(!valid)throw Fail("webhook signature does not match a trusted key");
        return (byte[])body.Clone();
    }
    public static T VerifyAndDecode<T>(byte[] body,IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string,IEnumerable<string>>> headers,IEnumerable<string> secrets,double? now=null,double tolerance=300,JsonSerializerOptions? options=null) {
        var verified=Verify(body,headers,secrets,now,tolerance);
        try{return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(verified,options) ?? throw Fail("verified webhook payload does not match destination type");}
        catch(JsonException){throw Fail("verified webhook payload does not match destination type");}
    }
}
